_comment: ADR-037 manifest fragment — business-rules-engine. Adds the Business rules menu entry + the custom RuleSets dashboard page. src/main.js mergeManifestFragments() concatenates these onto src/manifest.json's menu/pages arrays.

pages.title: Business rules
pages._note: Custom page hosting the business-rules engine dashboard (RuleSetsPage.vue). Lists RuleSets and opens the decision-table / condition-action editors and test sandbox. type:custom because the grid editors and sandbox are bespoke and no built-in page type covers them.
